title: Staff Technical Program Manager ML/AI Platform
summary: As a Staff Technical Program Manager focusing on cross-engineering special projects, you will identify, scope, champion, and land key strategic projects important to advancing Pinterest’s platform and underpinning. You will lead high-impact initiatives for ML/AI Platform, GenAI infrastructure, and Agent Platforms while operating with an AI-First Execution Mindset.
requirements: 8+ years of TPM or related experience
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent
Proven track record of leading complex, multi-year initiatives spanning multiple engineering teams
Demonstrated ability to use GenAI to accelerate program planning and operations
Experience turning repeatable program work into durable, low-toil mechanisms
Working understanding of Machine Learning, GenAI, LLM serving, AI Agent architectures, DevOps, and systems engineering principles
Strong analytical and decision-making skills with a track record of using data to navigate complexity
Outstanding written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills
nice_to_haves: Vibe coding lightweight scripts and tools
Knowledge of MLP, Agent Platform (Helix), Core Infra, and Ads domains
Experience in high-toil workflow modernization (intake triage, status synthesis, risk tracking)
